reviewed_by: a native speaker of Marathi, via the project owner
note: Reviewed by a native speaker of Marathi on 16 October 2026 (D175). Four decisions from that review are recorded here because they shape every future string. Punctuation is the full stop: modern Marathi — newspapers, government circulars, WhatsApp — uses '.', and the danda '।' reads as Sanskrit or old poetry. प्राधिकरण is not used in prose; the natural word is संबंधित विभाग, and यंत्रणा: is the label in what_where_long. A category word carries समस्या, because a bare adjective (बांधकामविषयक) or abstract noun (पर्यावरण) does not read as a problem inside '{ward} विभागात {thing}.'. And the status lines say काम झाल्याचा rather than ते दुरुस्त झाल्याचा, because 'repaired' only makes sense for a broken object and these sentences also describe uncollected garbage and a felled tree. BMC's own term for an administrative ward is विभाग; प्रभाग is an electoral division and must not be used here (glossary). 'distressed building' is जीर्ण झालेली इमारत and deliberately not धोकादायक इमारत: a photograph does not establish that a building is dangerous.
